definitions.gloss: individual packaging; single-dose packaging; portioned packaging
definitions.explanation: The practice of dividing and packaging items into individual portions or doses. Most commonly used in pharmacy for dividing medication into single-dose packets, but also applies to food and other products.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{分包|ぶんぽう}してもらった。
examples.english: I had my medicine divided into individual packets.

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}が{一杯|いっぱい}{分|ぶん}ずつ{分包|ぶんぽう}されていて{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: The tea is individually packaged per cup, which is convenient.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}が{飲|の}み{間違|まちが}えないように、{薬局|やっきょく}で{薬|くすり}を{一回分|いっかいぶん}ずつ{分包|ぶんぽう}してくれる。
examples.english: The pharmacy packages medication into single doses so elderly patients don't take the wrong amount.

notes:
Composed of {分|ぶん} (divide, portion) and {包|ぽう} (wrapping, packaging). Most commonly encountered in pharmaceutical contexts, where pharmacists use a {分包機|ぶんぽうき} (dose-packaging machine) to divide medications into individual packets. Each packet is labeled with the time of day it should be taken. Also used in food packaging for single-serving portions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分包|ぶんぽう}する: to package individually
- {分包機|ぶんぽうき}: dose-packaging machine
- {一回分|いっかいぶん}{分包|ぶんぽう}: single-dose packaging

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with {文法|ぶんぽう} (grammar), which has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個包装|こほうそう}: individual wrapping — used more broadly for individually wrapped items like candy or snacks
- {小分|こわ}け: dividing into small portions — more colloquial and used for food portioning at home
